TABLE.NAME: datalynx_waypoints
TABLE.COMMENT: Derived query index over itinerary field values. Authoritative data lives in datalynx_contents; this table exists only because lat/lng there are unindexed TEXT columns, and is safe to rebuild at any time.

FIELD.NAME: seq
FIELD.COMMENT: Zero based position of this stop in travel order

FIELD.NAME: timeplanned
FIELD.COMMENT: Planned time at this stop, null when not given

INDEX.NAME: fieldid-lat-lng
INDEX.COMMENT: Bounding box pre-filter for corridor matching

INDEX.NAME: entryid-fieldid-seq
INDEX.COMMENT: Ordered read back and delete on save
